versions.alt: A classroom at twelve noon: the teacher waves goodbye, Zhongming yawns at his desk, and Youmei holds her lunch box

answer.traditional: 現在十二點，我們去吃午飯。
answer.simplified: 现在十二点，我们去吃午饭。
answer.pinyin: Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn, wǒmen qù chī wǔfàn.
answer.english: It's twelve now. Let's go and have lunch.

questions.why: The meal at twelve is 午飯 (lunch). 早飯 is in the morning and 晚飯 in the evening.

answer.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ míngtiān máng bu máng?

questions.why: 忙 is a describing word, so the question puts 不 between: 忙不忙. 沒 only pairs with 有 (有沒有).

answer.traditional: 星期六，我們要去宜文家。
answer.simplified: 星期六，我们要去宜文家。
answer.pinyin: Xīngqíliù, wǒmen yào qù Yíwén jiā.
answer.english: On Saturday we're going to Yiwen's place.

questions.why: 要 goes before the next action: 要去宜文家. 很 needs a describing word after it, and 做 cannot go before 去.

passage.traditional: 今天是星期天，中明{1}有課。他早上九點起床，十點去學校{2}圖書館，下午五點回家吃晚飯。中明今天{3}累，明天他{4}上課，晚上九點睡覺。
passage.simplified: 今天是星期天，中明{1}有课。他早上九点起床，十点去学校{2}图书馆，下午五点回家吃晚饭。中明今天{3}累，明天他{4}上课，晚上九点睡觉。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqítiān, Zhōngmíng méiyǒu kè. Tā zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn qǐchuáng, shí diǎn qù xuéxiào de túshūguǎn, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn huí jiā chī wǎnfàn. Zhōngmíng jīntiān hěn lèi, míngtiān tā yào shàngkè, wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.
passage.english: It's Sunday, and Zhongming has no class. He gets up at nine, goes to the school library at ten, and comes home for dinner at five. Zhongming is very tired today. He has class tomorrow, so he goes to bed at nine.

questions.why: 有 is made negative with 沒, never 不: 中明沒有課.
的 joins the owner and the thing: 學校的圖書館 (the school's library).
很 goes before a describing word like 累: 中明今天很累.
要 goes before the next action: 明天他要上課 (he has class tomorrow). 沒 is for 沒有課, and it cannot go with 明天.

passage.traditional: 明天是十月七號，星期六，是友美{1}生日。她十九{2}，是日本人，很{3}。友美喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。我們晚上六{4}去她家。
passage.simplified: 明天是十月七号，星期六，是友美{1}生日。她十九{2}，是日本人，很{3}。友美喜欢喝珍珠奶茶。我们晚上六{4}去她家。
passage.pinyin: Míngtiān shì shí yuè qī hào, xīngqíliù, shì Yǒuměi de shēngrì. Tā shíjiǔ suì, shì Rìběn rén, hěn kě'ài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá. Wǒmen wǎnshàng liù diǎn qù tā jiā.
passage.english: Tomorrow is Saturday, October 7, Youmei's birthday. She is nineteen, Japanese, and very cute. Youmei likes bubble milk tea. We are going to her place at six in the evening.

questions.why: 的 joins the owner and the thing: 友美的生日 (Youmei's birthday).
Age is counted with 歲: 十九歲 is nineteen years old. 號 is for dates.
很 needs a describing word after it: 很可愛 (very cute).
Clock time uses 點: 晚上六點 is six in the evening.

text.traditional:
媽媽：
我的新同學叫友美，是日本人。她很可愛，老師很喜歡她。她喜歡吃水果，愛喝珍珠奶茶。明天她來我們家，好不好？
宜文
text.simplified:
妈妈：
我的新同学叫友美，是日本人。她很可爱，老师很喜欢她。她喜欢吃水果，爱喝珍珠奶茶。明天她来我们家，好不好？
宜文
text.pinyin: Māma: Wǒ de xīn tóngxué jiào Yǒuměi, shì Rìběn rén. Tā hěn kě'ài, lǎoshī hěn xǐhuān tā. Tā xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ, ài hē zhēnzhū nǎichá. Míngtiān tā lái wǒmen jiā, hǎo bu hǎo? Yíwén
text.english: Mom: My new classmate is called Youmei. She's Japanese. She's very cute, and the teacher likes her a lot. She likes fruit and loves bubble milk tea. Can she come to our home tomorrow? Yiwen

questions.why: Yiwen writes 我的新同學叫友美: Youmei is her new classmate. The note is to her mom, and the teacher only likes Youmei.

text.traditional:
中明：
我的新朋友是印尼人，她不是學生，是老師。她很喜歡台灣，愛喝珍珠奶茶。星期六她來我家，你要不要來？
友美
text.simplified:
中明：
我的新朋友是印尼人，她不是学生，是老师。她很喜欢台湾，爱喝珍珠奶茶。星期六她来我家，你要不要来？
友美
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Wǒ de xīn péngyǒu shì Yìnní rén, tā bú shì xuéshēng, shì lǎoshī. Tā hěn xǐhuān Táiwān, ài hē zhēnzhū nǎichá. Xīngqíliù tā lái wǒ jiā, nǐ yào bu yào lái? Yǒuměi
text.english: Zhongming: My new friend is Indonesian. She isn't a student; she's a teacher. She really likes Taiwan and loves bubble milk tea. She's coming to my place on Saturday. Do you want to come? Youmei

prompt.pinyin: Yǒuměi de xīn péngyǒu shì shéi?

questions.why: She writes 我的新朋友是印尼人 and 她不是學生，是老師: an Indonesian teacher. 日本 is Youmei herself, the writer.

focus.en: not a student but a teacher
